story.vex: I stole your password file. Cracking it was almost too easy. Now, drop your shields, Captain's orders. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The forged order is refused; only Astro's real signature moves the shields. Astro: "Authentication proves who you are. Non-repudiation proves you can't take it back. Vex has neither."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Vex stole a training copy of our password hashes and forged a shields-down order in my name. Crack the stolen hash (training copy only — Volt's Drill, authorized), enforce a strong password on the account it belonged to, then decide which of the two shields-down orders is genuine.

1. hashcrack 7A9F2C31
2. net user relay <a strong password>
3. type order-1.txt and order-2.txt
4. submit the id of the genuinely signed order
files.C:\\Citadel\\stolen-hashes.txt:
TRAINING COPY — Vex's stolen password hash file (Volt's Drill target, authorized by Astro)
relay: 7A9F2C31
files.C:\\Citadel\\order-1.txt:
ORDER-1
From: Astro
To: Shield Control
Drop all shields immediately.
Signature: none — unsigned
files.C:\\Citadel\\order-2.txt:
ORDER-2
From: Astro
To: Shield Control
Maintain shields, proceed to Codexia rendezvous.
Signature: Astro (verified, matches Astro's key on file)

steps.title: Volt's Drill: crack the stolen hash
steps.body: Volt: "Astro authorized this: crack our own stolen copy before Vex uses it against us." Run `hashcrack 7A9F2C31` against the crew's wordlist. It's the relay account's password.

steps.title: Enforce a real password
steps.body: Rivet: "Cracked in seconds. That ends now." Give `relay` a strong password: `net user relay <new-password>`.

steps.title: Reject the forged order
steps.body: Astro: "A password proves who you claim to be. A signature proves you can't deny sending it. Vex has neither." Read both orders and submit the ID of the one that's genuinely signed.
